result.instructions: Tools for CultureMonkey, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the employees in our CultureMonkey directory who are on the Customer Success team."; "Add Priya Menon to CultureMonkey with external_id EMP-10482 in Bengaluru."; "Move employee EMP-10482 to the Revenue Operations team and update her designation.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes CultureMonkey data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run culturemonkey_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run culturemonkey_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run culturemonkey_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. culturemonkey_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: culturemonkey_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List one page (100 employees) of the account's employee directory: names, emails, external_id, team, location, manager, dates and active status. The reply has meta.total_page; call again with page+1 until it passes that number. Read-only. GET /api/v1/employees.

page.description: Page number, 100 employees per page (default 1). Stop when the page passes meta.total_page.

tools.name: culturemonkey_get_employee
tools.title: Get employee
tools.description: Fetch one employee by external_id, the stable id your system assigned. Read-only. GET /api/v1/employees/{external_id}.

external_id.description: The employee's external_id: the stable id from your own system (HRIS profile id, for example).

tools.name: culturemonkey_create_employee
tools.title: Create employee
tools.description: Add an employee to the directory. Required: first_name, email_address, external_id, team_name, location_name. A team, location, sub-team, business unit or group that does not exist is created. A manager must already exist. Fails with 409 if external_id is taken (use update). POST /api/v1/employees.

external_id.description: The employee's external_id: the stable id from your own system (HRIS profile id, for example).

employee_id.description: Optional HR identifier (not the lookup key; external_id is).

manager_email.description: Manager's email. The manager must already exist in CultureMonkey.

manager_employee_id.description: Manager's employee_id. The manager must already exist in CultureMonkey.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth, YYYY-MM-DD. Personal data: send only when needed.

gender.description: Gender, as your CultureMonkey account expects it. Personal data.

employee_type.description: Employment type, as your CultureMonkey account defines it.

role_type.description: Role type, as your CultureMonkey account defines it.

tools.name: culturemonkey_update_employee
tools.title: Update employee
tools.description: Change fields of one employee, identified by external_id. Send only the fields to change; the others stay as they are. external_id itself cannot change. PUT /api/v1/employees/{external_id}.

external_id.description: The employee's external_id: the stable id from your own system (HRIS profile id, for example).

employee_id.description: Optional HR identifier (not the lookup key; external_id is).

manager_email.description: Manager's email. The manager must already exist in CultureMonkey.

manager_employee_id.description: Manager's employee_id. The manager must already exist in CultureMonkey.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth, YYYY-MM-DD. Personal data: send only when needed.

gender.description: Gender, as your CultureMonkey account expects it. Personal data.

employee_type.description: Employment type, as your CultureMonkey account defines it.

role_type.description: Role type, as your CultureMonkey account defines it.

tools.name: culturemonkey_deactivate_employee
tools.title: Deactivate employee
tools.description: Offboard one employee by external_id. This is a soft delete: it sets is_active to false, stops future survey sends and keeps the historical responses. No tool in this server erases data. DELETE /api/v1/employees/{external_id}.

external_id.description: The employee's external_id: the stable id from your own system (HRIS profile id, for example).
